audit.why: Emerald+ win rate 54.75% over 15 games; chart Skill / Mordekaiser x5 / Skill matches the mirror audit on Mel's page (which recorded HARD 8/10 for her side, phases Skill / Mordekaiser x5 / Skill). full:phases[N].side and content:win[N] already agree row for row, so no chart flips are proposed.
audit.corrected: Difficulty stays FAV 7/10, carry threat 8/10. No level-chart edits needed — both layers already read Skill, Mordekaiser x5, Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 and post-6 text calls Golden Eclipse (R) a reflect. Mel's reflect is Rebuttal (W), 26-38s; Golden Eclipse is a global Overwhelm detonation on 120/100/80s.
audit.why: enemyKit: W Rebuttal 'reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker, prevents her from taking damage', cd 38/35/33/29/26. R Golden Eclipse range 25000, cd 120/100/80, damage scales with Overwhelm stacks.
audit.corrected: Level 6 spike is Realm of Death (650 range, 140s at rank 1) isolating her where Golden Eclipse's global reach is worth nothing and only Rebuttal's 26-38s window can blank your burst.

audit.whatIsWrong: No page text named the decisive interactions: Rebuttal blanking damage (not reflecting Morde's non-projectile Q/E), Solar Snare's 1000-range root on a 9-11s cooldown, and Searing Brilliance's Overwhelm execute threshold.
audit.why: Obliterate (675, ground smash) and Death's Grasp (700, pull) are not projectiles, so Rebuttal cannot bounce them — it simply prevents her taking damage while it lasts. Solar Snare is the only hard CC in her kit; its cooldown is the whole engage timer. Overwhelm stacks consume to execute, which a health bar does not warn you about.
audit.corrected: Bait or wait out Rebuttal (26s at rank 5) before dumping Obliterate; engage inside Solar Snare's 9-11s downtime; track the execute HP number rather than the bar.

audit.corrected: Added concrete numbers to breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, mid, spikes[1] and wants.foe[1].

edits.before: He kites your slow kit — E-pull the step-up, then drag him into the Realm where he can't run. Mordekaiser wins by trading around Mel's Solar Snare and cashing the pattern: pull his misstep and win the Realm 1v1.
edits.after: She kites your slow kit — Death's Grasp her step-up, then drag her into the Realm where she can't run. Mordekaiser wins by trading around Solar Snare's 9-11s cooldown: pull her misstep and win the Realm 1v1.

edits.before: - Mel Solar Snare: matchup-defining — Her root / slow zone — sets up her combo. Dodge it. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Mel Solar Snare (E): matchup-defining — a 1000-range root on 11s at rank 1. Dodge it, then engage inside that window.

edits.before: Her root / slow zone — sets up her combo. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Solar Snare (E) roots at 1000 range on an 11s cooldown. Dodge it, then step up inside that window.

edits.before: Whiffing Q into the wave and trading with no passive stacks — un-isolated Obliterate hits soft, and without Darkness Rise you lose most even exchanges.
edits.after: Realm of Death is 140s at rank 1 and only 650 range — spend it once Solar Snare is down and she has stepped up, never to chase a Mel still kiting on full cooldowns.

edits.before: Darkness Rise ramps in extended trades and Indestructible heals her chip — she has no dash to escape the aura once you're on her.
edits.after: Darkness Rise ramps and Indestructible heals her chip, but Overwhelm stacks execute on an HP threshold — disengage on a number, not a health bar.

edits.before: Realm of Death isolates her into a 1v1 where her R reflect is one cooldown and no teammate can peel — your guaranteed pick window.
edits.after: Realm of Death isolates her into a 1v1 where Rebuttal is one cooldown to bait and no teammate can peel — your guaranteed pick window.

edits.before: Realm of Death banishes Mel into a 1v1 shadow realm — her R reflect becomes one cooldown to bait and no teammate can peel, your cleanest pick window all game.
edits.after: Realm of Death banishes Mel into a 1v1 shadow realm — Rebuttal becomes one 26-38s cooldown to bait and no teammate can peel, your cleanest pick window all game.

edits.before: "This is your lane. Through 4-5 Darkness Rise ramps in every extended trade and your W heals back her chip. At 6, Realm of Death is the kill button — banish her and her R reflect is a single cooldown you can bait or just out-DPS in a 1v1 with nobody to peel. Force the all-in when your R is up — don't dump your burst into her while she's full and her reflect is loaded, or it bounces straight back."
edits.after: "This is your lane. Through 4-5 Darkness Rise ramps in every extended trade and your W heals back her chip. At 6, Realm of Death is the kill button — banish her and Rebuttal is a single 26-38s cooldown you can bait or just out-DPS in a 1v1 with nobody to peel. Force the all-in when your R is up — don't dump Obliterate into her while Rebuttal is loaded, or the whole trade lands on nothing."

edits.before: Hold her R reflect to bounce your all-in burst and Realm engage back, then survive the Darkness Rise window
edits.after: Hold Rebuttal to blank your all-in burst inside the Realm, then survive the Darkness Rise window on move speed

edits.before: Bank Indestructible in extended trades and force the all-in on your magic-pen first-item spike, not while her R is up
edits.after: Bank Indestructible in extended trades and force the all-in on your magic-pen first-item spike, once Rebuttal is spent

notes: suspectNames flagged 'Bank Indestructible' in wants.you[2] as a probable wrong name — it is a FALSE POSITIVE: Indestructible is Mordekaiser's own W. The real error across this matchup was calling Golden Eclipse (R) a 'reflect'; the reflect/damage-blank is Rebuttal (W), 38/35/33/29/26s, and it cannot bounce Obliterate or Death's Grasp because neither is a projectile. Level chart already agrees across both layers and with the Mel-side mirror, so no chart edits were proposed. Not asserted (kits do not cover it): whether Rebuttal blocks Realm of Death's cast, and whether Solar Snare's root can be cleansed out of mid-Realm.
